event_summary: An orange ball descends into a black crate on a wooden tabletop and then remains mostly contained inside it.
raw_event_description: At the start, a glossy orange ball is visible near the top center of the frame above an open black lattice crate sitting on a wooden table. For many frames the ball stays above the crate with little visible change. Later the ball moves downward, reaches the crate opening, becomes partly hidden by the crate rim and front lattice, briefly shows more of its upper portion above the rim, then settles lower so that only orange portions are visible through the crate openings and near the top opening.

reasons: The orange ball is partly cropped by the top edge of the frame.
The black crate and wooden table are clearly visible.
The ball is visibly above the crate opening.
